MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for Default Prove-Up Hearing this day.

Paul Lee, Esq. for Plaintiff: Portside Homeowners' Assoction.
Plaintiff's Witness: Kevin Seward, was sworn and direct examined.
